title: English Practice Quiz 0867
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: A suspicious login alert should prompt you to:
options: verify activity and report through approved channels
questions.explanation: Verify and report possible unauthorised access.

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: A QR code from an unknown source may:
questions.explanation: Unknown QR codes can direct users to unsafe sites.

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: A secure website connection is commonly indicated by:
questions.explanation: HTTPS indicates an encrypted connection, not guaranteed legitimacy.

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: You should share an OTP:
questions.explanation: An OTP is a private authentication code.

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: A backup is useful because it:
options: helps restore data after loss or damage

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: A spoofed email address is:
options: disguised to appear to come from another source

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: Why use public Wi-Fi cautiously?
options: open networks may expose data to interception
questions.explanation: Unsecured networks can expose transmitted information.

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: If a USB drive is found, you should:
options: follow procedure and avoid plugging it in
questions.explanation: Unknown USB devices may contain malicious software.

questions.question: Cyber Awareness: Software permissions should be:
Cyber Awareness: Social engineering attempts to:
options: manipulate people into revealing information or unsafe actions
questions.explanation: Social engineering exploits human trust or behaviour.
